label: AT-3(2)
title: Physical Security Controls

statement.prose: Provide {{ insert: param, at-03.02_odp.01 }} with initial and {{ insert: param, at-03.02_odp.02 }} training in the employment and operation of physical security controls.

guidance: Physical security controls include physical access control devices, physical intrusion and detection alarms, operating procedures for facility security guards, and monitoring or surveillance equipment.

params.label: personnel or roles
guidelines: personnel or roles to be provided with initial and refresher training in the employment and operation of physical security controls is/are defined;

params.label: frequency
guidelines: the frequency at which to provide refresher training in the employment and operation of physical security controls is defined;
